title: A code-lane land's first pass cannot fetch the code branch after the push and ends not done, so each code item needs a second land run
goal: One backlog.py land run of a code-lane item waits for its merge request and finishes, or says exactly why it did not: when the code/<id> branch is already gone from the remote after the push (the merge request auto-merged and removed its source branch, so the fetch finds no remote ref) and the commits are on the remote main, land waits on those commits, not on a missing branch tip.

run:
import sys,subprocess,tempfile,os;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land
from pathlib import Path
t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
env=dict(os.environ,GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='a',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='a@example.com',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='a',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='a@example.com',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='/dev/null',GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM='/dev/null')
g=lambda *a,cwd=t:subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=cwd,env=env,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
g('init','-q','--bare','remote.git')
g('clone','-q','remote.git','work')
w=t/'work'
g('checkout','-q','-b','main',cwd=w)
(w/'f').write_text('x')
g('add','f',cwd=w)
g('commit','-q','-m','c',cwd=w)
g('push','-q','origin','HEAD:refs/heads/main',cwd=w)
tip=bl_land.pushed_tip(w,'origin','code/ST-aaaaaaaa')
sys.exit(0 if tip and g('rev-parse','HEAD',cwd=w) in tip else 1)

notes: Likely cause, not proven: kg_sync.push_options sends merge_request.auto_merge and merge_request.remove_source_branch, so a merge request that merges at once removes code/<id> before land's pushed_tip fetch, which then reports no tip. Also read: land without --wait-merge is two-pass by design (the first pass says so before the push); the repro covers the missing-branch fetch only. SP-ep7ck2ab (2026-11-08/09): about 9 code-lane items, BG-dq3lxnqm the last, ended land's first pass with 'could not fetch code/<id> from origin after the push' because the merge request had already merged and its branch was gone; each needed a second land run.
